chunks: As for what Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan, from Yazīd ibn Isḥāq Shaʿīr, from Hārūn ibn Ḥamzah al-Ghanawī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
I asked him about the takbīr in the two ʿĪds. He said: seven and five.

key_terms.التَّكْبِيرِ: the pronouncement of 'Allāhu akbar' within the prayer
key_terms.الْعِيدَيْنِ: the two ʿĪd prayers, ʿĪd al-Fiṭr and ʿĪd al-Aḍḥā
key_terms.خَمْسٌ: five; the number of takbīrs in the other ʿĪd prayer
key_terms.سَبْعٌ: seven; the number of takbīrs in one of the two ʿĪd prayers

ai.seo_question: How many takbīrs are there in the salat of the two ʿĪds according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the number of takbīrs in the salat of the two ʿĪds. It indicates a legal ruling concerning the structure of ʿĪd prayer, specifying that they are seven and five.
